description: This file declares the ApplicationManagementServer class, which implements the IApplicationManagementServer interface for IPC-based application management in the Rialto server. It includes method declarations for initialization, event sending, starting, stopping, and handling client disconnections, along with private members for thread management and IPC components.

classes.name: ApplicationManagementServer
classes.description: Implements the IApplicationManagementServer interface, managing IPC server lifecycle, client connections, and event communication within the Rialto server.

methods.name: ApplicationManagementServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server with factory and session manager dependencies.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the IPC server with a socket.

methods.name: sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends a session state change event to clients.

methods.name: onClientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a client disconnects.
